name: FAI_GENAI_REQUESTS
description: This table stores request and response data for generative AI related requests.

columns.name: GENAI_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Autogenerated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_FLOW_ID
columns.description: Autogenerated alternate key for this table.

columns.name: DESIGN_PATTERN
columns.description: The design pattern of the request. For example, a Completion request.

columns.name: DESIGN_CODE
columns.description: The design code of the Fusion AI entity associated to the request. For example, the prompt code for a completion request.

columns.name: DESIGN_VERSION
columns.description: The design version of the Fusion AI entity associated to the request. For example, the prompt version for a completion request.

columns.name: REQUEST
columns.description: The JSON payload of the generative AI request.

columns.name: RESPONSE
columns.description: The response related to the request. For example, the response returned by the large language model for a completion request.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
